entry.title: Resolution 511 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HAWAI‘I SADDLE CLUB, INC., FOR THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF A NEW ROPING CHUTE FOR THE HONOKA‘A RODEO ARENA

Transfers $9,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 1)

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 511-26 - 04/08/26
